opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: Applicants can apply for up to £200,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the award duration, based in a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation; up to two Co-applicants from different Academy remits.
opportunities.summary: Cross-disciplinary, curiosity-driven research awards in partnership with the Royal Society, Royal Academy of Engineering and Leverhulme Trust, supporting interdisciplinary research at the boundary between science, engineering, and the social sciences and humanities.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call; previous successful recipients are not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a GLAM organisation or performing arts organisation.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027

amount.raw: The symposium covers travel, accommodation, and visa costs; seed funding available for collaborations

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany.
opportunities.summary: Research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', bringing together early career researchers from the UK and Germany in the humanities and social sciences.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: 80 per cent of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC; three-year award

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation; British citizens, EEA nationals, or anyone with a UK doctorate; must not have held a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers to pursue an independent research project towards a significant piece of publishable research, funded by DSIT.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in the humanities and social sciences ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO.
opportunities.summary: Awards to promote the acquisition and advancement of skills in areas such as quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities and languages, supporting innovative research methods.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: Up to £300,000 over 2 years (80% FEC; total project value at 100% FEC up to £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from the humanities and social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute, of postdoctoral or above status, with overseas Co-Applicants required.
opportunities.summary: International interdisciplinary research programme on the theme of Mobilities, led by and grounded in the humanities and/or social sciences, collaborating across SHAPE and STEM disciplines.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27

amount.raw: Up to £150,000 for 12 months (with Full Economic Costing at 80 per cent)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships offering UK-based early- and mid-career researchers the opportunity to embed themselves in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin, developing skills, networks and careers in policy and related sectors.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: Funding of up to £4,000 (exceptional cases above £4,000 considered)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders or applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require, such as specific equipment, assistance for sensory impairment, caring costs, or support to make an application.

opportunities.title: British Academy/Leverhulme Small Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral scholars (or equivalent) ordinarily resident in the United Kingdom; independent scholars may apply.
opportunities.summary: Small research grants covering the cost of expenses arising from a defined research project, tenable for up to 24 months, funded as a public-private partnership including DSIT, Leverhulme Trust and Wellcome Trust.
